title: Most played tracks
statementMd:
The 5 most played tracks with their play counts. Ties by track title then id.

Expected columns: `title`, `plays`.

Tables: `artists`, `albums`, `tracks`, `listeners`, `plays`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT t.title, COUNT(*) AS plays FROM plays p JOIN tracks t ON t.id = p.track_id GROUP BY t.id, t.title ORDER BY plays DESC, t.title, t.id LIMIT 5;
```
